pt-BR: {dir} olhar em volta    {info} voltar ao jogo
notes: Button hint at the bottom in info mode. Icons; keep the four spaces.
Button hint at the bottom in info mode.
Info mode, on the board. From fish_routines.fbasic.

en: {dir} moves the cursor. Hold {swap} and press {dir} to swap two fish. Connect three or more of the same kind to pop them.
pt-BR: {dir} move o cursor. Segure {swap} e aperte {dir} para trocar dois peixes. Junte três ou mais do mesmo tipo para estourá-los.
notes: {dir} and {swap} are button icons.
fr: {dir} déplace le curseur. Maintiens {swap} et appuie sur {dir} pour échanger deux poissons. Relie-en trois ou plus de la même espèce pour les faire éclater.
de: {dir} bewegt den Cursor. Halte {swap} und drücke {dir}, um zwei Fische zu tauschen. Verbinde drei oder mehr der gleichen Art, damit sie platzen.
pl: {dir} rusza kursorem. Przytrzymaj {swap} i naciśnij {dir}, by zamienić dwie ryby. Połącz trzy lub więcej tego samego rodzaju, by je zbić.

notes: Info mode, on the score bar.

en: Popping fish fills the bar, and bigger groups are worth more. Fill it to finish the round and pick an upgrade.
pt-BR: Estourar peixes enche a barra, e grupos maiores valem mais. Encha-a para terminar a rodada e escolher uma melhoria.
fr: Faire éclater des poissons remplit la barre, et les gros groupes rapportent plus. Remplis-la pour finir la manche et choisir une amélioration.
de: Platzende Fische füllen den Balken, größere Gruppen zählen mehr. Ist er voll, endet die Runde und du wählst ein Upgrade.
pl: Zbijanie ryb napełnia pasek, a większe grupy są warte więcej. Napełnij go, by skończyć rundę i wybrać ulepszenie.

notes: Info mode, on the move counter.

en: How many swaps you have made so far.
pt-BR: Quantas trocas você fez até agora.
de: Wie oft du bisher getauscht hast.

notes: Info mode, on the rounds counter.

en: How many rounds are left to play. Every round needs more score than the one before.
pt-BR: Quantas rodadas faltam. Cada rodada pede mais pontos que a anterior.
fr: Le nombre de manches qu'il reste à jouer. Chaque manche demande plus de points que la précédente.
de: Wie viele Runden noch zu spielen sind. Jede Runde braucht mehr Punkte als die davor.
pl: Ile rund zostało do rozegrania. Każda runda wymaga więcej punktów niż poprzednia.

notes: Info mode: the title over the diver, on the board. The words of every info.board key only say what a thing is, never what it does. Titles fit about 200 px.

en: Somebody came down to have a look around.
pt-BR: Alguém desceu para dar uma olhada.
notes: Info mode: about the diver. Wraps at about 300 px.
fr: Quelqu'un est descendu jeter un œil.
de: Jemand ist heruntergekommen, um sich umzusehen.
pl: Ktoś zszedł na dół się rozejrzeć.

notes: Info mode: the title over a fish with a rainbow outline. It is a secret, so say only what it looks like.

en: A fish with every color on it.
pt-BR: Um peixe com todas as cores.
notes: Info mode: about a rainbow fish. Do not explain what it does.
fr: Un poisson de toutes les couleurs.

notes: Info mode: the title over the krill that a quest puts on the board.

en: Tiny, and there are a lot of them.
notes: Info mode: about the krill.
de: Winzig, und es gibt eine Menge davon.

notes: Info mode: the title over the seaweed that a quest puts on the board.

en: It grows from the bottom up.
pt-BR: Ela cresce de baixo para cima.
notes: Info mode: about the seaweed.
fr: Elle pousse du bas vers le haut.
de: Er wächst von unten nach oben.

notes: Info mode: the title over the sand dollar that a quest puts on the board.

en: Flat and round, and not worth a thing.
pt-BR: Achatada e redonda, e não vale nada.
notes: Info mode: about the sand dollar. A small joke on its name: it is not money.
fr: Plat et rond, et ne vaut pas un sou.
de: Flach und rund, und keinen Pfennig wert.
pl: Płaski i okrągły, i nic nie wart.

notes: Info mode: the title over the turtle that a quest puts on the board.

en: In no hurry to get anywhere.
notes: Info mode: about the turtle.
Info mode: the title over the glass fish that a quest puts on the board.

en: You can see right through it. Handle with care.
pt-BR: Dá para ver através dele. Cuidado ao manusear.
notes: Info mode: about the glass fish.
de: Man kann direkt hindurchsehen. Vorsicht zerbrechlich.

notes: Info mode: the title over a bottle on the board.
Info mode: about a bottle. There is a message in it.
fr: Quelque chose est roulé à l'intérieur.

notes: Info mode: the title over a jellyfish on the board.
Info mode: about a jellyfish. A hint that it stings.
fr: Molle, et mieux vaut ne pas y toucher.

notes: Info mode: the title over a stingray on the board.

en: Flat, and fast when it wants to be.
notes: Info mode: about a stingray.
fr: Plate, et rapide quand elle le veut.
de: Flach, und schnell, wenn er will.

notes: Info mode: the title over a fish with a ring on it, put there by the quest of the round.

en: The quest has its eye on this one.
pt-BR: A missão está de olho neste.
notes: Info mode: about a fish that the quest marked.
fr: La quête a l'œil sur celui-ci.
de: Die Aufgabe hat diesen hier im Auge.
pl: Zadanie ma tę rybę na oku.

notes: Info mode: the title over the bones of a fish.

en: There is not much left of this one.
notes: Info mode: about a skeleton.
fr: Il ne reste pas grand-chose de celui-ci.
de: Von diesem ist nicht viel übrig.

notes: Info mode: the title over a fish that floats belly up.
Info mode: about a fish that is belly up.
Info mode: the title over a cell that has more fish stacked behind the one that shows.

en: More fish are hiding behind this one.
pt-BR: Há mais peixes escondidos atrás deste.
notes: Info mode: about a stack.
fr: D'autres poissons se cachent derrière celui-ci.
de: Hinter diesem verstecken sich noch mehr Fische.
pl: Za tą rybą chowają się kolejne.

notes: Info mode: the title over one fish picked at random. It says which way that fish faces.
Info mode: the same as info.board.left.

en: Every fish faces one way or the other.
pt-BR: Todo peixe está virado para um lado ou para o outro.
notes: Info mode: under info.board.left or info.board.right.
fr: Chaque poisson regarde d'un côté ou de l'autre.
de: Jeder Fisch schaut in die eine oder die andere Richtung.
pl: Każda ryba patrzy w jedną albo w drugą stronę.

notes: Info mode: when two things on the board are on the same cell, the second is added to the first like this. {$title} and {$desc} are the second thing's title and words.
Info mode: the name of a button on the right of the screen that opens the codec (the book of everything found so far; same word as menu.codec). Short: about 100 pixels.

en: Everything you have found so far. Press {confirm} to open it.
pt-BR: Tudo o que você já encontrou. Aperte {confirm} para abrir.
notes: Info mode: what the Codec button says when there is nothing new in it. {confirm} is the confirm button's icon; keep it.
fr: Tout ce que vous avez trouvé jusqu'ici. Appuyez sur {confirm} pour l'ouvrir.
de: Alles, was du bisher gefunden hast. Drücke {confirm}, um ihn zu öffnen.
pl: Wszystko, co do tej pory znalazłeś. Naciśnij {confirm}, by otworzyć.

en: There is new info to read! Press {confirm} to open it.
pt-BR: Tem informação nova para ler! Aperte {confirm} para abrir.
notes: Info mode: what the Codec button says when something new has been found since it was last read. {confirm} is the confirm button's icon; keep it.
fr: Il y a du nouveau à lire ! Appuyez sur {confirm} pour l'ouvrir.
de: Es gibt Neues zu lesen! Drücke {confirm}, um ihn zu öffnen.
pl: Są nowe informacje do przeczytania! Naciśnij {confirm}, by otworzyć.

notes: A small badge that bounces on the Codec button in info mode, and over the info key hint at the bottom of the screen, while there is something new to read in the codec. Very short: about 60 pixels, drawn small.
Info mode, the Codec spot: one line of the list of what is new in the codec. {$name} is the name of a codec entry. Keep the bullet.
Info mode, the Codec spot: the last line of the list of what is new, when there are more than six. {$count} is how many more (1 or more).

en: Press {confirm} to list everything on the board.
pt-BR: Aperte {confirm} para ver tudo o que está no tabuleiro.
notes: Info mode: added after info.grid.desc while the board is highlighted, when there is something on the board to list. {confirm} is the confirm button icon; keep it. Wraps at about 300 px.
fr: Appuyez sur {confirm} pour voir tout ce qu'il y a sur le plateau.
de: Drück {confirm}, um alles auf dem Spielfeld aufzulisten.
pl: Naciśnij {confirm}, by zobaczyć wszystko na planszy.

notes: Info mode: the title of the list of what is on the board (jellyfish, coral, upside down fish...). Each row of the list is one of the info.board titles and a number. About 140 px.
Button hint at the bottom while the list of what is on the board is open: choose a row, go back to the board, or leave info mode. Icons; keep the four spaces.

en: Press {confirm} to look closer, cell by cell.
pt-BR: Aperte {confirm} para olhar de perto, casa por casa.
notes: Info mode: the words beside the whole board. The confirm key puts a cursor on the board, to look at what is on each cell. {confirm} is the confirm button icon; keep it. Wraps at about 138 px.
fr: Appuyez sur {confirm} pour regarder de plus près, case par case.
de: Drück {confirm}, um Feld für Feld genauer hinzusehen.
pl: Naciśnij {confirm}, by przyjrzeć się z bliska, pole po polu.

en: {dir} look around    {confirm} choose    {info} back to game
pt-BR: {dir} olhar em volta    {confirm} escolher    {info} voltar ao jogo
notes: Button hint at the bottom while looking closer at the board: move the cursor from cell to cell, choose one of the things on the cell, or leave info mode. Icons; keep the four spaces.
fr: {dir} regarder autour    {confirm} choisir    {info} retour au jeu
pl: {dir} rozejrzyj się    {confirm} wybierz    {info} wróć do gry

notes: Info mode, looking closer at one cell of the board: the title of a row of the panel on the left. Fits about 110 px. Like every info.board key, it only says what a thing is, never what it does. An ordinary fish, with nothing else to say about it.
Info mode, looking closer at one cell: the words under that row. Wraps at about 134 px, small text; one short sentence. Under 'A Fish': there is nothing special about it.

Info mode, looking closer at one cell of the board: the title of a row of the panel on the left. Fits about 110 px. Like every info.board key, it only says what a thing is, never what it does. The squid that turns up on the board at night. Use the same word as angler.topic.squid.ask.

en: It came out when night fell.
pt-BR: Ela apareceu quando a noite caiu.
notes: Info mode, looking closer at one cell: the words under that row. Wraps at about 134 px, small text; one short sentence. About the squid. Do not explain what it does.
fr: Il est sorti à la tombée de la nuit.
de: Er kam heraus, als die Nacht anbrach.

notes: Info mode, looking closer at one cell of the board: the title of a row of the panel on the left. Fits about 110 px. Like every info.board key, it only says what a thing is, never what it does. A cell that the squid has inked.
Info mode, looking closer at one cell: the words under that row. Wraps at about 134 px, small text; one short sentence. About the ink. Do not explain what it does.
fr: Quelque chose de sombre a coulé ici.

notes: Info mode, looking closer at one cell of the board: the title of a row of the panel on the left. Fits about 110 px. Like every info.board key, it only says what a thing is, never what it does. A cell that the dried ink of the day has been washed off of; it glows.
Info mode, looking closer at one cell: the words under that row. Wraps at about 134 px, small text; one short sentence. About a cell whose ink has been washed off. Do not explain what it does.
fr: Lavé à fond, et qui brille.
